title: Vitamin D: could it be holding your strength back? ☀️
caption:
Many people run low in winter or indoors. Supplements helped strength a little, mostly in people who were low. Get a blood test instead of guessing. 👇

General information, not medical advice.

Supplement Series, Part 6
first_comment: When did you last get your vitamin D checked? ☀️
sources: Beaudart C et al. The effects of vitamin D on skeletal muscle strength, muscle mass, and muscle power: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials. J Clin Endocrinol Metab 2014;99:4336-4345 (small strength gain, larger when deficient)
Holick MF. Vitamin D deficiency. N Engl J Med 2007;357:266-281
Institute of Medicine. Dietary Reference Intakes for Calcium and Vitamin D. 2011 (upper limit 4,000 IU a day for adults)
